summary: Completed comprehensive testing of System Status feature (backend + frontend) and regression testing. All critical functionality working correctly.
passed_tests: Backend: GET /api/health/live returns 200 with version (7 char commit or null), uptime_seconds (int, increasing)
Backend: GET /api/admin/system-status without auth returns 401/403
Backend: POST /api/auth/login with admintest/admin123 returns 200 with admin role
Backend: GET /api/admin/system-status with admin auth returns 200 with full structure (version, startup, database, runtime)
Backend: No secrets exposed in /api/health/live or /api/admin/system-status responses (checked DB password, WEBHOOK_CRON_SECRET, EMERGENT_LLM_KEY)
Backend: Regression endpoints work - /api/units, /api/operations, /api/bonus-admin, /api/admin/backup/info all return 200
Backend Priority Scenario 1: SOURCE_COMMIT env variable takes priority (version=abcdef1, commit_source='env SOURCE_COMMIT', branch=main)
Backend Priority Scenario 2: build_info.json used when no SOURCE_COMMIT (version=1234567, commit_source='build_info.json')
Backend Priority Scenario 3: No version info doesn't crash (version=null, server still starts)
Backend DB Failure: /api/health/live returns 200 even with DB failure (startup_ready=false)
Backend DB Failure: Other endpoints return 503 with friendly message 'Server sedang menyiapkan database'
Frontend: Login with admintest/admin123 successful
Frontend: Help & Backup page (/bantuan) loads correctly
Frontend: SystemStatusPanel appears ABOVE tabs (panel y=196, tabs y=549)
Frontend: All 3 cards present (Version, Database, Server)
Frontend: Version card shows commit (7 chars: 20f1bc2), copy button, branch (fix/coolify-mariadb-url), build time, commit source (git)
Frontend: Database card shows 'Tersambung', latency (0.3 ms), MariaDB version (10.11.18-MariaDB-0+deb12u1), 28 tables
Frontend: Server card shows uptime (2 menit), startup time, platform (Preview / lokal), domain, Python version, port
Frontend: Overall badge displays 'SEMUA NORMAL'
Frontend: Refresh button works (time updated from 17.12.32 to 17.12.34 WITA)
Frontend: Auto-refresh text displayed ('otomatis tiap 30 dtk')
Frontend: Responsive layout - cards stack vertically on mobile (390px viewport)
Frontend: No horizontal overflow on mobile
Frontend: Regression - Help page tabs work (Panduan Penggunaan, Backup & Pemulihan, Integrasi WhatsApp clickable)
Frontend: Backup panel functional (download button, backup info showing 221 baris · 27 tabel)
Frontend: No console errors on page
